adjudication.rationale: In `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb` the “multiple hosts” setup fabricates `EmbeddableHost` records including `host: 'https://example.com/1234'`. The model `EmbeddableHost` has a `before_validation` callback that normalizes `host` by stripping scheme and path (`sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` and `sub!(/\/.*$/, '')`). The spec never asserts that the stored value was normalized (e.g., to `example.com`), so if normalization behavior regressed, the failure would likely show up indirectly as an “invalid referer host” controller/spec failure rather than a clear unit-level assertion. This is a concrete test robustness/coverage gap tied to the new normalization logic, not a proven runtime bug.
